done_when: When the review check fails to start on GitHub, close stops at once, says the review check failed to start on GitHub, and gives a step that starts it again (a new commit or reopening the pull request) instead of forge close.

Gate: Update the shipped recovery instructions

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - GitHub fails to start the review workflow while the separate pull-request test workflow runs.
The guard treats a skipped `Review pull request` job as evidence that the review started, so it never calls `_no_start`. New evidence from [the owner's actual failed run](https://github.com/knacklabs/symphony-forge/actions/runs/43905959995) shows that its head's [check runs](https://api.github.com/repos/knacklabs/symphony-forge/commits/c536b13d4196ebab40a9b706c79a183c7c8f57f6/check-runs?per_page=100) include a skipped `Review pull request` job from the separate test workflow. `_seen` includes that job, although the required `forge-pr-check` status is absent. Close therefore repeats the missing-check wait and recommends `forge close`. If a test also times out, `_tests_timeout` still reports the timeout instead, so the previous finding remains open.

why: When GitHub fails to start the pull request's review check, forge close keeps saying the review check has not reported and gives forge close again as the next step, so the same wait repeats and nothing starts the check.
